required_operator_fields.metric_authorities: Eight TRACE tasks only -> staged scorer path, function, key, scale_to_100, dependencies; uses_source for SARI. Six general overrides are refused when s8 is selected, otherwise ignored with a warning naming the keys.
required_operator_fields.admission_evidence: Probe name -> measured JSON evidence file reference. Never a bare valid:true.
required_operator_fields.native_probes: Study -> named probe -> command manifest reference (argv and files).

optional_config_fields.calibration_raters: Exactly two ordered distinct rater names. Default ["gpt-6-astra", "Claude Opus"]. These names must match the raters JSON keys exactly.
optional_config_fields.raters: File reference to JSON keyed exactly "gpt-6-astra" and "Claude Opus" by default, each mapping sealed pair IDs to labels -1, 0, 1. Use calibration_raters to declare other exact keys.
